title: Intention in deeds
text: Actions are but by intentions, and every man shall have only that which he intended...

title: Pillars of Islam
text: Islam is built upon five: testimony that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is His Messenger, establishing prayer, paying Zakah, fasting Ramadan, and Hajj to the House (if able).

title: Excellence of Qur'an recitation
text: The best among you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

title: Sincerity and following the Sunnah
text: Whoever introduces into this matter of ours that which is not from it, it is rejected.
